scope: Make Workspace answers read and look like a leading chat assistant: adaptive depth with no word limit, visuals placed under their own headings, borderless tables, metric tiles, block flow diagrams, one typography, right-to-left rhythm, no repeated copy of a visual and a stable view while answering. At the owner's request on 28 November, raise answer-program, chat-history and public-search size limits. Money limits and the private-data search filter are unchanged.

keep: The existing answer validators, saved answer text, Copy, Share, renderer library and model route
extend: Answer instructions let the model judge depth and use the whole visual library
Step-by-step diagrams are drawn as joined blocks; routed graphs keep the canvas
The browser sends up to 200 earlier messages whole instead of 1,200 characters each
Answer programs up to 200,000 characters keep their visuals
Public search asks for 25 results and keeps longer excerpts
The newest exchange keeps room under its prompt while it is answered
Reading rhythm for Arabic-script and Devanagari answers
replace: A complete written backup of every visual with the existing generated plain-text copy
An always-open chart data table with one that opens on request

architecture.reason: Changes instruction text, presentation and one comparison inside the existing answer path.

egress.description: Same destinations. Chat requests to the existing model carry more of the signed-in user's own conversation. Search requests ask for 25 results instead of 10. The private-data search filter is unchanged.

cost.description: No extra calls. Longer history raises input tokens and longer answers raise output tokens, both inside the existing per-user budget reservation and settlement. Search is billed per request, so its price is unchanged.

tests.scope: The saved copy of a visual is not drawn twice; unbound or different prose is left untouched.
A figure that rounds to the readout agrees; a different figure is still a conflict.
The instructions ask for concise answers and no written backup of visuals.
Script rhythm follows the dominant script and ignores a quoted word or plain numbers.
Downward flows become blocks; bypass, return and same-row links keep the routed graph.
Real browser acceptance of answers in both themes and phone to desktop widths, with no accessibility violations or external requests.

rollout: Backend and frontend together, after the parent chat release. Check real answers on a candidate before promotion.
rollback: Re-promote the previous verified backend revision and frontend build; no database changes.
knownGaps: Real model answers under the new instructions are not verified.
The server still sends the model the last 12 messages and 8,000 characters of each; raising it edits security-reviewed pipeline.ts and awaits the owner's approval to rebind those records.
Images, logos beyond the product registry and live market charts need new data providers.
The turn spacer is not verified in the signed-in Workspace or on a physical phone.

blockers: Founder approval and live answer acceptance on a candidate.
